what: The pair of files CFM builds for the tyre-size list snehove-retaze-20261105 with the Pilot-Pro XL supplement (8 codes N16280 to N16287, release manifest of 2026-11-21), copied byte for byte. It is the copy the build starts from; while the shop runs, the release manifest brings the pair CFM has published since (src/lib/catalog-release, section tyreSizes).

release.supersedes: release 1 of 2026-11-15 (manifest version 47): 145 codes, 13 families, 5 323 rows
release.announced: CFM announcement of 2026-11-21: +8 codes N16280 to N16287, +1 family snowdrive-pilot-pro-xl named "SnowDrive Pilot-Pro XL", no new size page, the list id unchanged
release.verified: NOT yet a pair taken from the live manifest. On 2026-11-21 08:48 UTC /api/catalog/status still showed release 1. These bytes were produced by CFM's own builder (tyre_sizes_refresh.build_pair: velkosti.build with_pages and the XL supplement, families.build_pinned with_names, branch claude/project-thread-a613mq, commit c8a98a3b) from its sealed batches; the same builder without the supplement reproduces release 1 byte for byte (sha256 05a0eff6... and 9215c714...). Once CFM publishes, compare the sha256 and the seals of the live pair (/api/catalog/status, tyreSizes) with the ones below and replace the files if they differ.

velkosti_20261105.json.producer: CFM, backend/apps/catalog_pages/publication/tyre_sizes_refresh.py (build with the card state, with_pages and the XL supplement backend/artifacts/snehove_retaze/produkty_xl_20261120.json)
velkosti_20261105.json.values_source: the sealed batch of 145 snow-chain and snow-sock products (batch id snehove_retaze_produkty_20261105) and the sealed XL supplement of 8 products (batch id snehove_retaze_produkty_xl_20261120, Lampa compatibility list, October 2026) read with the state of the cards in CFM: the manufacturer's fit list and, for the DAC and Menabo codes, the previous shop's cards. Which sizes have a page of their own (pages, 864) is CFM's decision. Public data only (code, tyre size, rim, tyre condition, source label); no internal CFM id, price or supplier name.

rodiny_20261105.json.values_source: the public code (pn), the family key, the family's brand and line, CFM's own name for a model whose label carries a Slovak noun (name) and the size label printed in the product's name, from the same sealed batch and the XL supplement. Which other codes the shop may offer when a code does not fit a size; it decides nothing about fit (the size list does).
